pillars.title: The Neutral Mask: The Blank Page of the Body
pillars.description: The Neutral Mask is the fundamental reference point beneath all theatrical performance—a state of calm, balance, and open curiosity. By stripping away personal mannerisms and psychological anecdotes, the actor experiences the "first time" of awakening and discovering space. Through physical preparation and movement analysis, the body develops an economy of gesture and an authentic, unshakeable scenic presence.

pillars.title: Mimodynamics & Poetic Transposition
pillars.description: Everything moves. Creativity flourishes when performers embody the inner dynamics of nature—elements, materials, colors, and animals—and transpose them into human passion and character. This is not literal pantomime, but mimodynamics: finding the physical motor and dynamic impulse beneath every gesture and spoken word.

pillars.title: The Actor-Author & The Joy of Play
pillars.description: My workshops operate as creative laboratories where performers step into the role of actor-creators. Driven by the pleasure of play (le jeu), clear physical constraints, and urgent dramatic needs, actors learn to improvise, master spatial geometry, and build original performance pieces.
